levels.label: Two-source overlay
levels.status_display: Two explicit signals share one changed region
levels.allowed_claim: A local diff can group contract and behavior signals while retaining each evidence reference.
levels.forbidden_inference: The map computes a calibrated risk score or decides whether to merge.

levels.label: Review disposition
levels.status_display: Human review recorded on the region
levels.allowed_claim: A reviewer can mark the grouped region reviewed with a note.
levels.forbidden_inference: The review note is an approval or merge verdict.

levels.label: Unmatched evidence
levels.allowed_claim: Signals outside the selected diff remain unmatched with a reason.
levels.forbidden_inference: All relevant runtime evidence has been collected.

levels.label: External release
levels.allowed_claim: Hosting and external publication remain unverified.
levels.forbidden_inference: The review case is live on GitHub, portfolio, or Handshake.
